description: PREFERRED for load development: generate a work-up ladder (>=5 rungs required — coarser requests are refused LADDER_TOO_COARSE, never silently interpolated) from the published-reference or charge-only bookends down, with per-rung trajectory nodes and the full safety envelope. Requires an API key or subscriber token — anonymous callers are refused pre-compute. Returns the SAME envelope as POST /v1/ladder. SAFETY (verbatim policy): Returns modeled pressure and velocity from a physics solver, plus a safety envelope. This is NOT published load data. Always present the envelope, warnings, and disclaimer to the user; never state a single charge weight as a recommendation. Pressure fields (p_max_bar, p_max_psi, saami_max_bar) are modeled compliance-vs-SAAMI-ceiling indicators on the model's CUP-equivalent scale, while pressure_percent_saami is reported piezo-equivalent: the percent equals p_max_bar x 1.2783 / saami_max_bar, so it is NOT peak / ceiling as served. Not measured proof pressures and not accuracy-validated numbers: the validation corpus is velocity-only. Treat them as position relative to the ceiling, with real-world spread unknown. not_for_loading_decisions_without_published_data: this result is a model output. Do not work up a load from it alone — cross-check against published data for your exact components before loading.
